text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi... Trainer. How are you feeling? 
Because I feel absolutely terrible...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's because a gecko snuck into my room 
last night, you see...
choice_data_list: Did it take you a while to catch me?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I caught it right away. But it was just so 
adorable, I ended up fussing over it the 
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Thanks to that, I'm terribly 
sleep-deprived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart couldn't get enough sleep and 
was unable to properly rest.
